item.title: Version 0.1.2 (322)
item.description:
Bubble 0.1.2

  • Ask AI about a PDF, Word document, spreadsheet, or text attachment. You can turn off attachment reading in AI settings.
  • Review changes after an AI rewrite, keep the original alongside a translation, or automatically translate mail from a sender. Compose templates can now include a subject.
  • Hover over a day in the mail list for an AI recap, including travel and delivery details. Mark the day's mail as read and archive it with one undoable action.
  • See one event when several calendars contain the same meeting. Choose calendar colors, control which calendars count as busy, refresh the calendar, and email guests from the event.
  • Get a reminder two minutes before a meeting with a call link. Join or dismiss it without switching away from your work.
  • Browse folders by account, expand nested IMAP folders, and sort by unread count. From the account rail, mark the inbox as read or archive it with undo.
  • Open a task to edit notes, labels, priority, due date, and subtasks. Check off subtasks on the board and filter the Tasks widget.
  • Open a contact to find drafts and browse email by month. Load older messages from the server or select a whole group for bulk actions.
  • Set a sender name for each account or edit an IMAP account's server settings while keeping its local mail.

item.title: Version 0.1.1 (302)
item.description:
Bubble 0.1.1

  • Filter mail by sender, subject, folder, date, or attachment. Save searches you use often and search older mail on the server.
  • Use shortcuts on the conversation under the pointer. Press M to move it or L to find a label.
  • Change a snooze time from the Snoozed list. Gmail and IMAP also move snoozed mail out of the inbox and return it when Bubble wakes it.
  • Answer invitations from the inbox and review proposed meeting times in the conversation.
  • Mail changes made offline stay visible and retry when the account reconnects. Sync status shows how many are waiting.
  • Bubble asks before sending a new message without a subject and checks attachment sizes for your provider. Press Command-Z while the send bar is visible to restore the draft.
  • Long conversations open with the ten newest messages. Load earlier messages as you scroll, or press Command-F to find text in the conversation.
  • Scheduled update reminders appear in the main window. Bubble downloads updates in the background by default. Click Restart and update when the update is ready. Bubble also installs downloaded updates when you quit. What's New shows the release notes after you update.
  • Opening a connected app from Calendar or Contacts now switches back to Mail to show it.
  • Contact cards show every address in Roles.
  • iCloud sign-in retries with the updated app-specific password and preserves the original error if sign-in still fails.
  • Bubble updates the Dock and notifications badge counts and warns when macOS hides the badge.

item.title: Version 0.1.0 (283)
item.description: Update card in the main window: new versions download in the background, then Restart and update. Real version number in Settings, working update toggles.

item.title: Version 0.1.0 (280)
item.description: The demo account is removed on launch even if it is your only account; Bubble then asks you to add an account.

item.title: Version 0.1.0 (279)
item.description: New installs start without the demo account; removing the demo account clears all its data. Reset Bubble in Settings. Contact card roles, iCloud sign-in fixes, Dock badge fix, hover quick actions polish.
